name: Year-end money review
summary: Review your household money in two short sessions and set next year's targets together.

onboarding.prompt: Which accounts or areas will you look at?
onboarding.reaction: Good list. We'll make an agenda from it.
Great. Everyone gets the agenda ahead of time.

onboarding.prompt: Who should we invite to the sessions?
onboarding.reaction: Invite ready. They'll see only what you share.

onboarding.prompt: When do you want to have the review done by?
onboarding.reaction: Locked. Two sessions land before then.

onboarding.prompt: Tap two 60-minute slots for the sessions.
onboarding.reaction: Both sessions are on the calendar.

phases.name: Session one: look back
actions: What went well, what surprised you

phases.name: Session two: look ahead
benchmarks: Up to five targets set for next year
actions: Put next year's check-ins on the calendar

plan_blueprint.calendar: A prep reminder, two 60-minute review sessions on the chosen slots, and quarterly check-ins for next year.

approach_variants.habit: Make it a yearly ritual on the same week each year.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: finish both sessions within one week.
approach_variants.time: Fixed agenda with timed sections for each session.
approach_variants.reward: Plan a treat after session two.
approach_variants.resource: Prep checklist gathers every statement and log-in first.

guardrails: This plan is general education, not financial advice. Check big decisions with a qualified professional.
Account numbers and log-ins are never asked for; you enter only the totals you choose.
Sessions work best when everyone can speak openly; pause if it gets heated and pick it up another day.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed session is rescheduled to the next free slot within a week; if the deadline passes, the plan suggests one combined session.
